main_text.l: ligens non tam mineram Martis sive chalybis nativi) quam certum quoddam minerale Martii oppositum, de quo Tractatu ultimo inquit: Sal nostrum est Mercurius: Deinde addit: Sol & Luna nostra (unde scilicet Lapis hic Philosophorum existit) OBDUCTA EST SPHAERA SATURNI: quod quidem minerale auri radios (id est V. essentiam ejus) in se recipit & mirabili vi promovet in lapidem tingentem. Nihil his magis opertum, nihil magis etiam apertum: Si modo habeamus apertos oculos ad intelligendum radices mineralium & simplices & compositas.
In hanc sententiam idem Sendivogius tractatu decimo: Aurum (inquit) potest dare fructum & semen, in quo se multiplicat industria sagacis

page.notes: Printed text is in a woodcut border; the running head is CHEIRAGOGIA. Underlined and spaced capitals (OBDUCTA EST, SPHAERA SATURNI) are as printed. Some words are uncertain in the scan, notably "minerale" and "sagacis" at the line end, and "Martii"; read from low-contrast print. Show-through from the facing page is ignored.
